div.head: Gunda Kinzl’s talk at GUST
div.p: 16th May 2022: The Global Studies center of GUST hosts Gunda Kinzl’s talk about her research, attended by his excellency Mag. Marian Wrba, Austrian ambassador in Kuwait. Dr. David Wilmsen (American University of Sharja) kindly acts as a discussant.
